verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev supports waitpoint tokens to pause a running task until an external API call completes them (commonly used for human approval/webhook confirmation), management API/SDK calls like runs.list to trigger, cancel, or interact with runs externally, and realtime/streaming APIs to push updates into or out of running tasks. This directly covers sending signals/events from outside (API, webhook, or another workflow) into a running workflow. missing for 10: no explicit example of triggering a waitpoint token from a webhook payload end-to-end, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of external signal delivery beyond docs.
